node: Grid field services, lineworker productivity, inspection, and installation automation
summary: Expanded the universe around the labor-productivity chokepoint in grid field work. The strongest underfollowed candidates are not pure software or robotics plays; they sit in transmission hardware, electrical construction services, geospatial inspection, and autonomous inspection systems. PLPC is the most directly aligned underfollowed candidate because it combines transmission-line hardware, utility drone inspection services, and a reported robotic-installation partnership. MYRG is a reference/near-reference specialty contractor that can reveal whether labor scarcity is translating into pricing, backlog, and equipment/process productivity. NVEE is an underfollowed inspection/data lane through utility geospatial, vegetation, and transmission scanning. ONDS is a speculative micro-cap exception for autonomous drones and mission-critical networks in energy/critical infrastructure, but evidence of material utility revenue must be verified before promotion.
